eyebrow: Batch: run to completion, optimize for throughput
code:
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: nightly-fraud-scoring
spec:
  backoffLimit: 2
  template:
    spec:
      restartPolicy: OnFailure
      containers:
        - name: batch-scorer
          image: registry.internal/fraud-scorer:2.3.0
          args: ["--batch-size", "512"]
          resources:
            limits:
              nvidia.com/gpu: 1
caption: No one is waiting synchronously — a failed Job just retries, so Spot GPUs are fine here.

eyebrow: Real-time: stay warm, optimize for p99 latency
code:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: realtime-inference
spec:
  replicas: 3
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: model-server
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet: { path: /v2/health/ready, port: 8000 }
            initialDelaySeconds: 30
          resources:
            limits:
              nvidia.com/gpu: 1
caption: A caller is blocked on this response right now — replicas stay warm instead of scaling from zero.
